subject: math
description: Combine circle area, sector area, and polygon area to solve multi-step shaded region problems.
learningObjectives: Identify whether a shaded region should be found by adding or subtracting areas
Compute circle, semicircle, and sector areas using radius and central angle
Compute polygon areas that appear inside or around circles
Organize multi-step area solutions with labels, formulas, substitutions, and final units
Check whether a shaded area answer is reasonable from the diagram
prerequisites: Fraction of a circle from a central angle
Using pi in exact and approximate area answers
